title: What If?
content:
— I'm bored. Let's play a question game! — Emma said.

— Sure! What kind of game? — Lucas asked.

— I'll ask you hypothetical questions, and you have to answer using "if."

— Sounds interesting. Go ahead!

— Okay. What would you do if you won the lottery?

— If I won the lottery, I would buy a big house near the beach. What about you?

— If I won the lottery, I would travel around the world and visit as many countries as possible.

— Nice! Here's my question: What would you do if you could have dinner with any famous person?

— Hmm... If I could choose anyone, I would have dinner with a famous scientist. I would ask a lot of questions!

— Good choice. What would you do if you found a wallet full of money on the street?

— If I found a wallet, I would try to find its owner and return it. What would you do?

— I would do the same. Okay, next question: What would you do if you could live anywhere in the world?

— If I could live anywhere, I would choose a small city near the mountains. It would be peaceful and beautiful.

— Interesting. I think I would choose a big city. If I lived in a big city, I would have more opportunities to meet different people.

— That's true! Here's another one: What would you do if you could speak every language in the world?

— If I could speak every language, I would travel much more easily. I would also make friends from different countries.

— Great answer! What if you could go back in time?

— If I could travel back in time, I would visit an important moment in history. But I wouldn't change anything.

— Why not?

— Because if I changed something in the past, I might change the future completely!

— That's a good point. Okay, last question: What would you do if you didn't have to work for one year?

— If I didn't have to work for a year, I would learn new skills, travel, and spend more time with my family.

— I like that. If I had a whole year free, I would probably start a new project and finally write a book.

— Maybe we should stop playing and start making some of these dreams happen!

— You're right! If we worked hard enough, some of our "what if" questions might become reality one day.
